title: Kitchen: a stove needs a meal bill
applies_when: Ingredients exist but prepared meals are not replenishing.
approach: Use an existing stove when possible. A fueled stove can start before electricity; check fuel and the cook rather than waiting for a complete power system.
Add a simple-meal bill with an inventory target, not an unlimited meal backlog. For three ordinary colonists, 10 meals is a starting target to adjust for actual consumption and spoilage.
Restrict ingredients to intended foods and check dietary rules. Put a small ingredient stockpile near the cook so most work time goes into cooking.
verify: Bill enabled, allowed ingredients, skilled available cook, fuel or power, and finished meals.
reconsider: Meals spoil, ingredients run out, or the cook spends the day hauling.
